title: Training a Compact, Strong, and Realistic Text-to-Speech Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.14776v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-speech (TTS) systems are conventionally optimized for intelligibility and speaker similarity. However, neither objective captures the prosodic detail that distinguishes human performances from synthetic speech, leaving a realism gap that larger models and higher-quality data can narrow but not close. In the absence of an objective that directly targets this gap, realism remains a persistent challenge in TTS. We present Audio8-TTS, a compact 0.6B-parameter model for zero-shot voice cloning that achieves state-of-the-art performance in intelligibility and speaker similarity, with particularly strong results in perceptual naturalness. To align the training signal with human perception rather than signal-level fidelity, we construct a quality ladder from widely used open-source TTS systems and train a realism critic to assess generated speech against matched human recordings of the same sentences. translated_title: 训练一个紧凑、强大且逼真的文本转语音模型
translated_abstract: 文本转语音（TTS）系统传统上以可懂度和说话人相似度为目标进行优化。然而，这两个目标都无法捕捉区分真人语音表现与合成语音的韵律细节，由此留下了逼真度差距——更大的模型和更高质量的数据可以缩小这一差距，却无法彻底消除。由于缺乏直接针对这一差距的优化目标，逼真度始终是TTS领域的一个持久挑战。我们提出了Audio8-TTS，这是一个仅0.6B参数的紧凑零样本语音克隆模型，在可懂度和说话人相似度方面达到了最先进的性能，在感知自然度方面的表现尤为突出。为了使训练信号与人类感知而非信号层面的保真度对齐，我们基于广泛使用的开源TTS系统构建了一个质量阶梯，并训练了一个逼真度评判器，将生成的语音与相同句子的匹配真人录音进行对比评估。一个身份擦除目标……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Audio8-TTS是一个仅0.6B参数的紧凑零样本语音克隆模型，通过从开源TTS系统构建质量阶梯并训练逼真度评判器来使训练信号对齐人类感知，从而在可懂度、说话人相似度和感知自然度上均达到最先进水平。
en_tdlr: Audio8-TTS is a compact 0.6B-parameter zero-shot voice cloning model that achieves state-of-the-art intelligibility, speaker similarity, and perceptual naturalness by aligning the training signal with human perception through a quality ladder built from open-source TTS systems and a trained realism critic.
